q: How does a government office or department calculate its carbon footprint?
title: Carbon footprint for a government office
short: Start with what the office controls: diesel for official vehicles and generators as Scope 1, and electricity for its buildings as Scope 2 at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. Add official travel and major purchases as Scope 3 later. Departments with many buildings should report each site separately, then total.

ul: Fuel slips for official vehicles and generators.
Travel claims for flights and trains.

p: Buildings shared with other departments: count the share on your bill or meter. Contractors running services keep their own fuel, which you can add as Scope 3.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site, and labels estimates as estimates.
